reviews.text: Kiki always comes back shiny and new and she loves everyone at the Furbar 😻 …

I highly recommend Stormi’s pet groomer! They do such a wonderful job taking care of Stormi, and I’m always happy with the results. Stormi is my little toy Poodle, and she deserves the very best care, love, and attention. It means so much to know she is in good hands and treated with kindness and patience.

Thank you for making Stormi look beautiful, feel comfortable, and leave looking like the little princess she is! 🐩💕 I truly appreciate your excellent service and the care you give her. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend you to anyone looking for a loving, professional, and reliable pet groomer!

Stormi and I are so grateful for you! ❤️🐾
always efficient and immaculate. Such a good job!

I am always satisfied with Furbar!  My princess, Freedom,  gets very nervous and clingy when I drop her off and they are very understanding.  I so appreciate that.  Thanks, also to Melissa who always delivers!

Snow loves going to Furbar North York. We are grateful to Melissa always making Snow look cute and pretty with different clips each visit.
Happy I found a Bichon Frise groomer close to home!
The staff is fantastic,  the place of business  is very clean. And  the best is Sammy and Gino love the place.
Amazing service all around. I highly recommend to anyone looking for a great quality cut for their dog - and the best customer service.
Lazy or unqualified. My puppy was "difficult" so they gave half a haircut. Do not recommend much better options in the area
Alfie was very happy and looks handsome
Thank you Melissa and team at Furbar on Dufferin for always doing such an incredible job our our furbaby Civic. Thank you for the great customer service and making us feel at home.

Huw always comes out looking gorgeous. He is known for being a happy boy. The staff are friendly and send reminders/pick up time messages, respond quickly to messages and bookings. We don't go anywhere else, prices are good, parking available.

Meaghen (spelling?) did an amazing job with Kitty Miss Meow. She was very conscientious in taking care of Kitty Miss Meow's grooming needs and was very kind to her. I'd warmly recommend Meaghen (spelling?) for any and all grooming jobs. Thank you very much.
Really bad cut. :(
Staff are great with your pet they are very professional and your dog comes out looking like a million bucks look8ng like a day at the spa
Been going there twice already with my Tobee clean place good staff and they do an amazing job and Tobee was not stressed at all when I went to pick  him up
Friendly and the service was great
Definitely recommend Fur Bar as an excellent grooming facility.  Always happy with my dog Olly’s grooming.  Friendly service.
Melissa did a fantastic job grooming Miko. Its great to drop him off knowing he is safe and cared for. Thank you Melissa
Kowalski went in so happy and came out the same plus clean and SO handsome!!! They take such good care of my boy!

Absolutely the best service! My dog is now elderly and over the years and especially through the pandemic I had to see many groomers around the city. The care and attention at the Fur Bar goes above and beyond! I wish I took my dog to the Fur Bar many years ago, and highly recommend the Fur Bar over other grooming services in Toronto & even the GTA/ Vaughan & Markham.
Always a great experience bringing my dog for a spa day.  You always do an amazing job, thank you Team Fur Bar
Best groomers in Toronto!

I have tried most of the grooming services in the area and FUR BAR consistently over-delivers on service, quality and price. No matter how ratty and disheveled my dog looks (my bad), they take care and are very fair with pricing!
Highly recommend! Great staff and my dog looks amazing after her grooming. Thank you!

I have been going to Fur Bar on Dufferin for a couple of years now. Duke had some bad experiences in the past and was very skiddish and aggressive for awhile. However, they have always been very patient with him at Fur bar and although he isn't super fond of grooming, he is definitely no longer aggressive and more accepting of it. Thank you everyone at Furbar for being so patient and taking the best care of Duke!! He always looks so handsome when he's done! 😍

So so happy to have discovered this place. Rachel did such a wonderful groom of my Yorkie!!!
The ambiance is lovely, reception is friendly and efficient - prices are fair.

I had an excellent experience the first time I took my dog here for his very first grooming appointment. Rachel was amazing—she was gentle, did a great job, and my dog came back happy and comfortable. I was extremely pleased with her work.

Unfortunately, Rachel wasn’t available the second time, so we went with another groomer. This turned out to be a big mistake. My dog was shaved very unevenly, with some areas almost bald and others left patchy. I was told that my dog was “very nippy” and that we should groom him more at home.

While I do acknowledge that my dog can be nippy, he is groomed daily at home and bathed every two weeks. When treats are used and he’s properly distracted, he usually does very well. Regardless, the uneven and patchy shave was unacceptable.

This experience has honestly made me very nervous about taking him back here—or to another groomer at all. If you decide to come here, I strongly recommend booking with Rachel specifically.
Another amazing groom at Fur Bar. I can’t say enough about this place, the groom is always great and my dog comes home happy. Thank you.

Based on a referral  I decided to take my Leonberger to Fur Bar for grooming.  Leonbergers are a dog you do not clip or shave as it ruins their double coat.   To assure that they would not clip or shave the dog I brought him in to show them the dog and explain not to clip or shave the dog.   They understood my instructions and an appointment was set up.   Upon bringing the dog for its appointment  I again reviewed the instructions with the groomer Rachel herself.  She told me she understood and had groomed this breed before.

Now to be fair he came back nice and clean but they did exactly what she said she understood not to do and shaved his legs.   Sadly he looks odd but of course still a loved boy.

I simply do not understand why they ignored the instructions they said they understood and told twice.  In fact the person who made the appointment told me she put the instructions also in the computer under his booking.

My thought they are good at doing the simple run of the mill grooming but certainly do not follow instructions.

I have been bringing my dog here for just over around two years now and everyone is always very kind and helpful! He can be a bit of a handful (and I myself have a tendency to overshare in regards to him as I can get quite nervous passing him off to groomers!) and I am very thankful for their patience with me (and him!) and their continued understanding. Thanks guys!
Wito, Rufus and Carl pick this one as number one!!!

Melissa is truly an amazing groomer. My Morkie Baci, had a bad experience at another salon that left him extremely scared and unable to be groomed. Melissa took such great care of him and after just two sessions, was able to give him a full groom. She genuinely cared about Baci’s well-being and never tried to force the process. Her patience and compassion made all the difference. Thank you so much, Melissa!
Absolutely love, Fur Bar. There amazing with all our dogs. Carl, Rufus and Wito are always so perfectly clean when they go home. Thank you, Fur Bar for taking care of our boys.  ❤️🙏 …
Thank you great job .My dog Teddy loves coming  there all nice and friendly.  Thank you.
Luna loves her experience at Fur Bar!! She’s gone a few different times but a special thanks to Melissa for our last visit.
Always so great with my dog

Super friendly customer service! They are very easy to book appointments with and my kitty's nail trim is always super quick.
Would definitely recommend 🙂 …

Beautiful and gentle job every time! I have a white English bulldog and it’s safe to say I have tried almost every groomer in the city to clean AND DRY his folds properly. I came across Fur Bar and I will never go anywhere else. They are the first and only groomer that shampoos and properly dries a bulldog, who has very sensitive skin, in addition to cutting his nails short enough that they don’t grow out in a week but not too short that causes any issues. When I tell you I’ve tried and seen it all, no one else compares. Thank you to the team for taking such great care of my little man and keeping him clean for 24 hours until he decides to roll in mud again..

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Fur Bar Grooming is absolutely amazing! They took such wonderful care of our Moose — he came home looking and feeling fantastic! The staff is friendly, professional, and you can tell they truly love what they do. A special shout-out to Melissa for being so kind, patient, and attentive — Moose adores you! Thank you for always making the grooming experience such a positive one. Highly recommend Fur Bar to anyone who wants their pet treated with genuine care and love! 🐾
FurBar is great with both of our pups. They are always happy to see their groomers. Their staff are flexible and kind. Great service.

I am very pleased with my dog's grooming today,
It is exactly what I asked for.
It's flawless!
Thanks Melissa

These guys are the best
We had trouble with our Lulu having her nails cut.
Not for Fur Bar…Thanks for your help

This is by far the best groomer in the area. I have been taking my dog Alabama for over a year now to Fur bar and her reaction when going there tells me everything I need to know. She’s excited, happy and waging her tail which tells me she is being treated amazingly. Ana is super caring when it comes to Alabama. She remembers her paw issues and ear issues everytime I drop her off to make sure that she can groom my dog accordingly. The groom is always done flawlessly and always done the way I want it to be done - It’s worth every penny spent. The place is super clean and welcoming, friendly, knowledgable and Ana is clearly amazing at her job.

I brought my puppy here for her first professional groom, they did a wonderful job with her and she came out looking great. I was able to book the appointment online after filling out a quick profile as a new customer, we got a text confirmation very quickly after sending an appointment request. I will be taking my dog back here again.
Groomer was amazing and they did wonderful with my golden Mabel.

I brought in my dog, Estrella, for a nail trim and grind and I’m so happy with the results! Estrella is very anxious around strangers so my previous attempts to get her nails trimmed at other salons failed. I explained my concerns to Aidan who was so understanding and patient. He gave Estrella time to adjust to the environment and successfully trimmed her nails - no one has ever been able to do that! When I came back to pick her up, she showed absolutely zero signs of stress. She was smiling, jumping around and happily wagging her tail. Aidan gave me tips on how to upkeep her nails at home, he’s truly a pro in what he does! I definitely recommend this salon, the team here is welcoming and I look forward to coming again in the future! Thank you again! 🐾💜
Fur Bar is 10/10 service and atmosphere!! Dexter loves coming to them and every interaction is pleasant!! I could not imagine going anywhere else. This is the go to for all your pets needs!! 😍 …
As always, Snoopy is very happy with his haircut and looks extremely handsome. 👍 …

We had an incredible experience! We took our husky to get a deshedding groom and the service was great. They were super attentive and she came out nice and clean. We will be coming back and recommend to anyone who needs their pet groomed.

I would give them zero stars if it was an option.
Took Rex there after recommendation from one of my cousins 3+ months ago. Was a great job the first time, and what I was looking for. They told us we should go back in 6 weeks. We agreed to this but when time came my wife had to travel home because her father passed away.
When I rescheduled for Rex approximately 2 months later, they kept insisting that I should have called 24 hours ahead and cancelled because there's a fee if not canceling in time, even though I told the front lady about our personal situation numerous times. No compassion. Anyway, the second time I paid 290$ INCLUDING tip and told them to cut his hair at the front and back a bit so he doesn't get dirty when eating or pooping, and the rest is grooming-- which includes removing his inner coat. I told her not to worry about the matted fur behind his ear because when my wife comes back she'll de-tangle without shaving, because we did not want him shaved. I clearly stated that.
After 5 hours the groomer did not do anything I asked them to. They shaved behind his ears, which I told them not to, and all they did was bathe him, and even that was done poorly, because after bathing they did not brush out or dry his inner coat, causing an infection three weeks after the appointment.
We followed up with them and explained what happened, and requested a discount for another appointment, since they did not groom him at all and we wanted them to fix this. They refused, and their customer service is a lie. If the business owners are reading this, don't bother replying. I am already aware of what kind of "solution" you're going to offer.
Don't waste your time and money there, and don't let your pet suffer at their hands, they do not have your pets best interest in mind. They want money.
There are so many better options, I should have searched a bit more, just last Saturday I took Rex for a dry grooming and for only 2 hours they removed his inner coat dry and jt cost me 100$ instead of 300$. These people are thieves.
Second time we've booked here, for grooming of our Golden Retriever. Very friendly and professional service! (Also, booking process is really easy & staff respond very quickly to communications.)

We’re always so happy with the service at Fur Bar North York. We’ve been bringing our big old bear (Lab/Husky) to Anastasiia for awhile now and she does a phenomenal job. She’s very patient, playful and professional with our furry bud. The facility is always clean and inviting and our guy always comes back happy, fresh and sparkly clean!
Great dog grooming and great friendly staff. Always doing good work
Thank you for your great review! We truly appreciate your support! 🥰😀 …
They groom our mancoons Sammy and Gino beautifully.  Thank goodness we found this place. We are regulars.  We like alot.🙂 …

“If I could give 10 stars I would”

“I’ve been a customer of Furbar for over 4 years, and I can’t recommend them enough. As the owner of two Himalayan cats and a mini doodle, I trust Furbar completely with my pets’ grooming needs. Their team is incredibly skilled, gentle, and attentive, making every visit a positive experience for my pets. The care, professionalism, and attention to detail they provide is unmatched — my pets always look and feel amazing after their appointments. Furbar has truly made grooming stress-free and enjoyable, and I’m so grateful for the consistent, excellent care they provide.” Thank you

I can't recommend them enough! They always take care of Mika, super professional, friendly but most importantly, super caring towards our cat. Mika loves them as well. She comes comes home happy every time!
Thank you for your lovely review! 🥰😀 …
Thank you for your great review very much appreciated!😀🤩🥰 …
We really appreciate your lovely review! It’s always a pleasure looking after your furry friend. Thank you for trusting us. We’re so glad they enjoy their time here!

Bud looks terrific after his trim. He has been bathed, blow dried, teeth and ears cleaned, toe nails clipped. The full meal deal and he is happy. Bud has been visiting FurBar for about a year now and I find them kind and thoughtful towards Bud
Didn't even clean my dogs ears, even though I payed $107 for bath,brush, and tidy.
Anastasia is my favourite and so gentle with my baby !! Thank you 🙏 …
Amazing hidden gem .. wonderful staff and groomers Melissa went over and beyond super grateful !! I will definitely be going back ..  Took great care of my baby .. thanks again
These folks are amazing. Careful, courteous and “cutting edge” results.

We have an older dog with some health issues. The team at Fur Bar (North York) has been amazing. They accommodate her needs and make sure she is as calm and relaxes as possible during her groomnig. Highly recommend.
It's a very neat, hospitable and animal carring business. I am happy, my cat is happy. What else to wish for!

So happy with Snow’s grooming! She looks and feels amazing — soft, neat, and so cuddly. The staff was incredibly kind and gentle with her, and I was told she behaved so well, which means she was comfortable (a big deal for her!). Thank you for taking such good care of her — we’ll definitely be back!
Always a pleasure going to Fur Bar on Dufferin. Always attentive and understanding of my cat. Always reliable.
Thank you so much for the great job that you did with my dog. I’ve been bringing my dog here for quite a while and they always listen to what I want.
Really nice people really nice groomers always on time and very thorough.

So glad I found FURBAR , the place I use to go to shut down and never told me.  Found your salon via Google and loved all the reviews.   Brought my handsome boy Gucci for first time back in March and yesterday was his second hair cut. Your entire staff is professional and Gucci gets tons of compliments on his hair cut. 💇‍♂️ thank you FURBAR the best by far.    Worth every cent !!
The only place we trust with our little Lulu—and for good reason! They always do an amazing job. Lulu comes back happy, clean, and smelling fresh every time

Love the staff, love all the gourmet and healthy treats, but most of all I love the cuts my pup gets. He always looks good, never ends up looking funny. Even when they needs to get in there an tackle any matting. 10/10 would recommend. The good boy gives 20/10 for treats.

Avoid this place for dog grooming, they shaved my dog and changed the pricing by 100$.  Thanks for giving my dog the worst haircut he’s ever had and then over charging me, this has to be the worst dog grooming business in the city.

This was for another location but same ownership group, don’t support this chain of dog grooming locations as they will shave your dog without your knowledge and try and charge you 230$.  Avoid these Fur Bar locations.

Thank you for doing such an optimal job on my morkie.  He looks so handsome after his grooming session.  As my dog means the world to me i am confident that he is in very good hands when I take him to get pampered at Fur Bar.  Halo gets many compliments from family and friends.  Thank you so much from Halo and mum and hope to see you in the New Year.   Great job and highly recommend.

Wonderful experience as a first time client! I took my senior cat (14) for his first professional groom as I noticed he’s having some difficulty grooming himself. They accommodated all my requests and it was clear they treated him with kindness

I brought my Yorkie here for grooming and had a wonderful experience! The groomer was incredibly kind and attentive, they even found a tick on my dog and let me know right away, which I really appreciated. The grooming itself was beautifully done; my pup looked and smelled amazing afterward. You can tell they really care about the animals they work with. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for professional and compassionate grooming services!
Anastasiia did an amazing job grooming Sushi! I’ve been looking for a groomer who can shape corgis 🍑 …
Thanks again Jon well done

The staff is amazing the manager was super helpful and very sweet in answering all my questions so my dog and I were comfortable. I am so happy I found them and can’t wait to bring my dog back for a full groom. I have found my new groomers. Thank you so much Otto is even more handsome. You staff are amazing your spot and everything is great I am so glad I have found you guys and look forward to brining Otto back and of course spoiling him with treats from your amazing shop. Thank you again Thank you Fur Bar on Differin.
Great groomers.  My dog happily goes.   Parking can sometimes be tricky

I'm so happy! It's first time I brought my fur babies here, Finally! Sundae and Gela had their nails trimmed. it's amazing how they handle Gela ( i was so concern that Gela might be difficult and would give the groomer a hard time especially with other pets around (she is reactive with others)  Definitely  Fur Bar will be my fur kids regular salon now. Thank you!🙏

We found this location in a desperate attempt to find a good place for nail trims and they did not disappoint! If I could give 10/10 I would, staff are very friendly and welcoming and they handled our pup with the utmost care (of course he was getting everyone’s attention lol). They even have a good selection of toys and treats that are natural and healthy for your pet! We will definitely be going back! Thank youuu FUR BAR!

Unfortunately due to us moving we won’t be able to go here anymore, but this place is absolutely FANTASTIC. I have tried multiple groomers and my golden doodle Luna would always be scared to go inside. For the first time a groomer makes her happy to gin inside and she always comes out happy. The staff here is wonderful and their work is second to none.
Anastasia was lovely. My dog can be really fussy about nail trims but this sessions was over in moments and my dog didn’t complain. Thx
Melissa was very professional. It was my first time taking my cat for a grooming and he was very reassuring. Highly recommend

Furbar was super helpful and quick! They did a great job trimming my kitten’s nails, and the whole process was smooth and stress-free. I really appreciate their care and efficiency. I’ll definitely be coming back!

Went there to try their services for the first time and we loved it. Staff were incredible, friendly and professional. My Niko came out happy and not stressed at all. They bedazzled him too which really made my day! Booked our next appointment right away.

Parking is available on site which is a huge plus.

Great grooming place. Our golden retriever looks fresh after every visit. Staff members are friendly.

Ample parking.

No complains about this place.
Melissa has been amazing with our fur baby Lexi. I highly recommend Fur Bar!
Caring, competent and on time!
Best groomer in the city, hands down! My dog actually loves going there. My dog is treated so well and they do the best job.

I took my dog here recently for the first time and it was perfect service. Not only is there a helpful chart with example examples of how short they can cut your dogs fur, but they had a photo book of different styles for his face. Since my dog is a Shih Tzu, there’s a lot of options with his type of hair and I really appreciated having this book to choose from. They also offer anesthesia, free tooth cleaning, which I will definitely take advantage of next time I need. My dog ended up peeing in his water ball and playing with the water so they had to give him a second bath. This was provided free of charge and I really appreciated this service. I will definitely come back and I have found my new regular dog groomer for my dog.
The staff are very friendly and I’m glad for their service to my pet lexie….
Thank you for the great review!

It was just by coincidence we found this place driving by, we were taking our cat Lulu to a later appointment at a different place to remove all her very matted fur. She is very difficult, temperamental and can be aggressive with strangers. We stopped by to check it out and we were greeted with a warm, friendly welcome and the facility was very clean and inviting.
We expressed our concerns to Melissa about our cat Lulu, she was very professional, knowledgeable and acknowledged our fears. She explained the challenges with cats and how it can be dealt with.
We were extremely pleased with the amazing job by Melissa. Lulu was very challenging to groom and Melissa had given us some great expert advice for future grooming. We love our little lion.
Love coming here. They love my dog and give me feedback on her behavior. Very nice girls that work here and feel very safe leaving my Mardi here.
Thank you for your review, very much appreciated! 😀 …
Very happy with the job and very nice and kind with the puppy! Really recommended

So happy that we found a grooming service for our puppy Maverick that we all enjoy! Staff are all amazing, friendly and attentive with our requests. I highly recommend Fur Bar for a great overall experience!!
Thank you for your amazing review!!
